home.title: Connect your devices
home.subtitle: Share this screen with another device, or enter the address and verification code of the device you want to control.
home.deviceIdHint: Hyphens are added automatically. The device must appear under Nearby devices.
home.nearbyHint: Devices found on this LAN. Click one to fill in the address; enter its verification code to connect.
home.noNearby: No nearby devices. Enable LAN discovery in Security on both devices.
home.noDevice: The local core is not reachable
home.noDeviceHint: Start molink-core, or open this page from the core.
home.connectSubtitle: Use the address and verification code shown on the other device.
home.rememberCode: Remember this code on this device
home.requestAccessHint: No code needed: the host approves this session (valid for 60 s)
home.connectSaved: Double-click to connect with the saved code
home.idNote: Direct connections work on the same network. Connecting by device ID uses the moLink Server configured in Settings.
home.modeControlHint: Keyboard and mouse control is on as soon as the session connects; you can turn it off in the session toolbar.
home.modeViewHint: Watch the screen without sending keyboard or mouse input.
home.tipCode: The verification code stays on this machine; keep it private. A single-use code expires after one session.
home.tipModes: Remote control enables keyboard and mouse as soon as the session connects. View only receives the picture.
home.tipTools: Chat and file transfer are always available in a session; clipboard sync can be turned off in the floating toolbar.
home.hostHint: The other computer address (IP or hostname). On a LAN you can pick it from Nearby devices.
home.idLookupHint: Resolve through the configured moLink Server, then connect directly.
home.serverRequired: Configure moLink Server in Settings first.
home.ipDisabledHint: IP connection is off. Enable it so others can reach this computer by IP.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.watermarkHint: Show FPS, latency and bandwidth in the corner of a session.
settings.qualityHint: Smooth favours frame rate with 16-bit colour; balanced keeps lossless tiles; quality spends more CPU on sharper frames; auto switches based on latency and link rate.
settings.autoLockHint: Lock the UI after this much inactivity while no remote session is open.
settings.networkHint: Port block: web/WS 28418, HTTP/3 28419, QUIC data 28420, TCP data 28421, UDP data 28422. Only the web/WS and UDP data ports are editable here; the reserved transports are advertised by /api/transports.
settings.allowRemoteHint: Takes effect immediately. Turning it off also closes active remote sessions.
settings.allowWebHint: Let a normal browser (not the desktop shell) load the web UI.
settings.discoveryHint: Multicast device discovery. Requires LAN / IP access.
settings.longTermHint: At least 8 characters with both letters and digits.
settings.customMultiHint: 4+ characters. The code rotates automatically after its uses run out.
settings.allowAccessRequestsHint: A remote user without a code can ask for access; you still approve every session. Enabled by default.
settings.windowsSessionsHint: Experimental: uses molink-service. Switching console or kicking RDP requires administrator rights.
settings.windowsServiceMissing: molink-service is not running. Install it as administrator (see shell/windows/service/README.md).
settings.windowsAdminRequired: Administrator rights are required for this action.
settings.serverHint: Register this computer with a moLink Server so others can connect by device ID.
settings.serverInviteHint: Required when the server enables an invite
settings.serverTlsHint: HTTPS is supported. Leave the CA empty for public certificates.
settings.autoSaveHint: Toggles apply immediately. Only the computer name needs Apply.
settings.serverCaHint: PEM bundle for a private/self-signed CA. Empty uses the system trust store.
settings.serverUsingDefault: Leave empty to use the built-in directory {{url}}.
settings.serverEnabledHint: When off, only LAN/IP connections remain and this device is no longer registered with moLink Server.
settings.domainRotateConfirm: The old domain code stops working immediately and other devices must rejoin. Continue?
settings.domainHint: Devices with the same domain code appear in each other's domain list; rotating the owner's code invalidates the old one immediately.

session.synthetic: Synthetic test pattern — screen capture is unavailable.
session.controlOnHint: Keyboard and pointer events go to the remote machine
session.controlHint: Enable control to send keyboard and pointer input
session.virtualMouseHint: Touchpad: drag to move, tap for left click, long-press for right click, two fingers to scroll.
session.waitingApproval: Waiting for the host to approve…
session.ctrlAltDelHint: Send Ctrl+Alt+Del (the secure screen ignores synthetic input; use the local keyboard to leave it)

error.title: Something went wrong
error.no_host: Enter the address of the device.
error.invalid_port: Port must be a whole number between 1 and 65535.
error.invalid_uses: Uses must be a whole number greater than 0.
error.device_not_found: No device is registered with that ID
error.clipboard_read_failed: Could not read the local clipboard
error.clipboard_write_failed: Could not write to the local clipboard
error.clipboard_unavailable: The browser does not expose the clipboard here
error.self_connect: This device cannot connect to itself.
error.server_unreachable: The moLink Server could not be reached

popout.noToken: This window is missing the connection code.

auth.lockedSubtitle: No activity for a while, so the UI locked. Enter the verification code to continue.
auth.loginSubtitle: Enter the verification code shown on this device.
auth.remoteNote: Local access is trusted. Access from another device always needs the verification code.
auth.invalid_token: The verification code is not valid.
auth.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.ip_banned: This address has been blocked after repeated failed attempts.

service.promptBody: The optional service enables remote access from the lock/login screen and Windows session switching.
service.promptLockScreen: Remote control on the lock screen and login page
service.promptSession: List, switch to console, or log off an RDP session
service.promptElevation: Installing needs administrator approval (UAC). The service starts and stops with the app.
service.installFailed: Service installation failed or was cancelled.
service.actionFailed: Service action failed. Administrator rights may be required.
service.panelHint: Start/stop needs no elevation after installation. Install/uninstall opens a UAC prompt.
service.homeHint: Install for lock/login-screen remote control and Windows session switching. Start/stop is remembered and reused on the next launch.

chat.title: Session chat
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say hello to the person at the remote screen.
chat.emptyHost: No messages yet. A remote viewer can start a chat from the session toolbar.

files.title: File transfer
files.dropHint: Drop files here, or choose files
files.receivePath: Saved to Downloads/moLink on the remote device
files.clipboardHint: Files copied in the remote Explorer. Receiving downloads them to this machine.
files.copied: Copied {{count}} file(s) to the remote clipboard
files.copyFailed: Could not set the remote clipboard

update.installHint: Download and run the latest installer
update.manualHint: Open the latest package in your browser

call.incomingBody: A client is calling this computer. Open moLink to answer.
call.no_mic: Microphone unavailable; you can only listen

simple.connectHint: Enter a device ID or an address; the port defaults to 28418
simple.requestHint: Without a code, the other side must approve
simple.avatarHint: Pick a preset colour or upload a small image (compressed automatically).
simple.avatarTooLarge: That image is too large; try a smaller one
simple.noticeServerOff: Remote ID server is off; LAN only
simple.natHint: Direct connections need the other side to be reachable; devices behind NAT may appear online but cannot connect.
simple.noSaved: Star a device to save it here.
simple.noLan: No LAN devices found. Enable LAN discovery in Security.
simple.lanLocalOnly: LAN discovery is only available on the host.
simple.serverDisabledHint: Turn on the remote ID server to see online devices.
simple.noOnline: No devices have been connected through the ID server yet.
simple.requestSent: Connection request sent; waiting for approval
simple.badAddress: Enter a valid device ID or address
simple.serverRequired: Enable the remote ID server or enter an IP address
simple.directoryBusy: The directory is busy; try again later
simple.lookupFailed: Could not reach the ID server
simple.domainRotateConfirm: Create a new channel code? Every device that joined the current code will stop seeing this group.
simple.domainFailed: Could not update the channel code
simple.domainHint: Devices on the same channel appear in the Channel list. Share the code with the people you want to connect to.
simple.domainHintUnregistered: The ID server (0.2.1 or newer) generates the channel code after registration; it cannot be created locally.
simple.domainRevokedHint: This channel code no longer exists. Ask its owner for a new one, or create your own.
simple.noDomainPeers: No other devices on this channel yet.
